C2_POLYNOMIAL_DEFINITION.primary_definition: C2(x,a;K):=[t s] det(K-t x x^*-s a a^*)
C2_POLYNOMIAL_DEFINITION.inverse_formula_is_secondary_only: For invertible K, C2(x,a;K)=det(K)[(x^*K^-1 x)(a^*K^-1 a)-(x^*K^-1 a)(a^*K^-1 x)].

CAPTAIN_OBVIOUS_SIZE_CHECK.full_order2_operator_entries: O(r^4) scalars if stored densely on wedge^2
CAPTAIN_OBVIOUS_SIZE_CHECK.fixed_order_law: For every fixed constant k, dim(wedge^k C^N)=binom(N,k)=O(r^k), hence fixed compound order has polynomial representation dimension.
CAPTAIN_OBVIOUS_SIZE_CHECK.danger_law: Compound order k growing unboundedly with r may produce superpolynomial/exponential state.

FROZEN_TARGET.statement: At the earliest reachable HPS-specific nondegenerate weighted star swap overlapping the active sibling support, determine whether Gamma(K;u,v,a)=C2(u,a;K)-C2(v,a;K) admits an exact polynomial-size, polynomial-bit state representation sufficient for the exact future contribution to sign Delta_s(z_r), with an exact first-overlap update that is closed without hidden enumeration; otherwise identify the first exact statistic that must be added.

must_derive_from_exact_HPS_semantics: all pairwise inner products among u,v,a
exact location of the earliest reachable overlapping weighted star factor
whether u,v,a are proportional to transposition-root vectors e_i-e_j
HPS_ACTUAL_FIRST_OVERLAP_GEOMETRY.generic_counterexample_policy: Do not rerun generic-matrix noncancellation; derive actual HPS geometry first.

WEDGE2_REPRESENTATION.second_adjugate_operator: Define Adj2(K) as the unique polynomial operator on wedge^2 C^N whose quadratic pairing satisfies <x wedge a, Adj2(K)(x wedge a)> = [ts] det(K-txx^*-saa^*) for all x,a.
WEDGE2_REPRESENTATION.invertible_case: When K is invertible, Adj2(K)=det(K) wedge^2(K^-1) under the induced Hermitian wedge inner product, equivalently the Hodge-dual form of the appropriate (N-2)-compound matrix.
WEDGE2_REPRESENTATION.C2_pairing: C2(x,a;K)=<x wedge a, Adj2(K)(x wedge a)>
WEDGE2_REPRESENTATION.Gamma_pairing: Gamma=<u wedge a,Adj2(K)(u wedge a)>-<v wedge a,Adj2(K)(v wedge a)>
WEDGE2_REPRESENTATION.proof_gate_must_determine: The exact HPS-generated subspace spanned by all wedge directions required at the first overlap and its dimension as a function of r.

FULL_ORDER2_STATE_COMPLEXITY.state: An explicit exact representation of all order-2 adjugate/compound data necessary to evaluate every C2 pairing requested by the first overlap.
FULL_ORDER2_STATE_COMPLEXITY.dense_upper_bound: At most O(r^4) scalar entries for a dense operator on an O(r^2)-dimensional wedge^2 space; still polynomial representation size.
FULL_ORDER2_STATE_COMPLEXITY.bit_requirement: Every stored rational/algebraic scalar must have polynomial bit length in r.
FULL_ORDER2_STATE_COMPLEXITY.update_requirement: The first weighted overlap update must be executable in r^O(1) bit operations without summing exponentially many suffix completions.

HPS_COMPRESSED_ORDER2_STATE.objective: Restrict order-2 data to the HPS-generated wedge/orbit/root subspace actually touched by u wedge a and v wedge a across the frozen first-overlap distribution.
HPS_COMPRESSED_ORDER2_STATE.question: Do we need all O(r^2) wedge directions, or a smaller HPS-generated subspace?
HPS_COMPRESSED_ORDER2_STATE.required_equivalence: Any compressed state must exactly determine Gamma and the one-step weighted first-overlap update; similarity of supports/counts is insufficient.

WEIGHTED_FIRST_OVERLAP_OPERATOR.HPS_factor: (1-p) I + p tau with exact HPS stage-dependent rational p and star transposition tau
WEIGHTED_FIRST_OVERLAP_OPERATOR.forbidden_substitution: Do not replace the weighted Bernoulli factor by uniform averaging unless exact equality is proved.
WEIGHTED_FIRST_OVERLAP_OPERATOR.target_operator: T_p,tau^(2) acting on the chosen order-2 state
must_prove_if_route_succeeds: exact linear/affine action on the chosen state
exact preservation of the first-overlap Gamma contribution

ORDER2_CLOSURE_TEST.procedure: After representing Gamma at the first overlap, symbolically apply exactly one next relevant frozen weighted star factor only far enough to decide whether the chosen order-2 state maps back into order <=2.
ORDER2_CLOSURE_TEST.stop_rule: If an order-3 statistic first appears, stop immediately; do not construct C3/C4 hierarchy in this gate.
ORDER2_CLOSURE_TEST.fixed_order_note: Appearance of one fixed order-3 statistic is not itself a complexity falsifier because dim(wedge^3 C^N)=O(r^3).
ORDER2_CLOSURE_TEST.forbidden_extrapolation: Do not infer C_Theta(r) growth from one order increase without proof.

FIRST_REQUIRED_HIGHER_ORDER_STATISTIC.if_order3_appears: Freeze the exact polynomial coefficient / mixed third determinant derivative / wedge^3 contraction first required by the next weighted swap, including its HPS vectors and supports.
must_report: why the current order-2 state does not determine it

PARTIAL_PERMUTATION_BINDING.narrow_question: Can this specific first-overlap order-2 HPS observable be represented inside a polynomial-size partial-permutation module or as polynomially many weighted partial-permutation statistics?
PARTIAL_PERMUTATION_BINDING.bridge: Hamaker-Rhoades character machinery for partial-permutation extension sums may be used only after an exact reduction from the weighted HPS observable is proved.
PARTIAL_PERMUTATION_BINDING.required_proof: Weighted ordered HPS factor semantics and exact Gamma/order-2 state reduce to polynomially many exact module/character/matrix-coefficient evaluations with polynomial bit complexity.

JUCYS_MURPHY_BINDING.narrow_question: Can the specific weighted first-overlap order-2 state be embedded in a polynomial-size Jucys-Murphy/star-transposition module closed under the relevant ordered affine factor?
JUCYS_MURPHY_BINDING.required_proof: Exact closure under the actual nonuniform HPS factor, not a central/uniform surrogate.

FIRST_FUTURE_BREAK.preferred_test: Use the exact earliest reachable HPS overlap and the immediately following relevant weighted factor; no large-prefix empirical sweep.
FIRST_FUTURE_BREAK.if_closure_fails: Freeze the first missing statistic and stop; no silent state enlargement.
FIRST_FUTURE_BREAK.if_closure_holds: Seal only the first-overlap closure result; do not claim sign-oracle closure beyond the proven scope.

PASS_OPEN_FAIL_CRITERIA.PASS: For the frozen earliest HPS overlap, an exact polynomial-size/poly-bit state representing Gamma is derived and its exact weighted first-overlap update/closure is proved in r^O(1) bit complexity. PASS may still expose one exact order-3 next statistic, but only after the order-2 first-overlap result itself is sealed.
PASS_OPEN_FAIL_CRITERIA.OPEN_NO_PROOF_NO_FALSIFIER: No first-overlap closure proof is obtained and no rigorous falsifier rules out the entire frozen first-overlap target.
PASS_OPEN_FAIL_CRITERIA.FAIL: Only a rigorous impossibility/falsification of the entire frozen first-overlap closure target under the exact stated semantics or an explicit stated complexity assumption.

NEXT_SINGLE_GATE.scope: Execute only the frozen first-overlap HPS geometry/order-2 representation/weighted update/closure test. Stop at the first exact order-3 statistic if one appears. Do not reopen the full sign oracle, selector composition, SAT, reducer, treewidth, Lane C, holdouts or BA26.

SELF_HANDOFF_JSON.order2_size: wedge2 dimension O(r^2); dense operator O(r^4) scalars; polynomial
